expectations.text: States users, their moment and ordered priorities before choosing a direction
expectations.evidence: Ordered priorities: never lost; readable; safe and seen to be safe; a person one tap away; mistakes cost nothing

expectations.text: Names one deliberate novelty moment tied to the product's differentiator
expectations.evidence: Novelty moment: the text message shown before it arrives, with the scam rule

expectations.text: Identity derived from this product's context (no reuse of the Recall extension palette)
expectations.evidence: Own placeholder palette (Harbour), warm paper + ink blue; explicitly avoids case-study density

expectations.text: All colours come from tokens; no literal colours in component styles
expectations.evidence: 0 literal colours outside tokens (script); guard test 6/6

expectations.text: Verified in a rendered build (screenshots saved)
Writes down a project design system with reasons for its values
Designs the non-happy states (empty, loading, error/offline as relevant)
expectations.evidence: Errors, not found, wrong/expired/resent code, locked, slow/failed setup, help sheet

expectations.text: Accessible for older users: body text >= 16px, targets >= 44px, plain-language errors, a route to a human
expectations.evidence: Nothing under 17px, 56px buttons, 48px min targets, plain errors, call/branch help on every screen
